entries.candidate: CloudHQ FRA Campus Offenbach — vorhabenbezogener Bebauungsplan Nr. 656 "Datencenter Kettelerstraße" (Kettelerstraße 100 / Mühlheimer Straße 164, Gemarkung Bürgel, Flur 7, Flurstück 253/7)
entries.reason: The Offenbach city council adopted B-Plan 656 as a by-law on 28 May 2026 (PIO Beschlussauszug 2026-31/DS-I(A)0032, issued 10 June 2026). The council also approved the implementation contract with Xaal Ventures S.à.r.l., CloudHQ's project company. That date falls outside the 85-day window (earliest 29 July 2026). The city lists the plan as legally binding, but its in-force notice date was not obtained: the 26.9 MB plan PDF timed out at 45 s and was not retried, and the offenbach.de notices and sitemap show no 656 entry. CloudHQ's campus page is undated and lists "RFS Entered Service 2023" and 112 MW, which conflicts with the 2026 planning record. It publishes the point 50.10932, 8.80648. No CloudHQ building permit, generator application or construction record was found. The site is not in the Atlas.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated record on or after 29 July 2026, such as the B-Plan 656 in-force notice, an Offenbach building permit, an RP Darmstadt generator notice for Xaal Ventures/CloudHQ or a CloudHQ release. The operator point would also need checking against Flurstück 253/7.

entries.candidate: Amazon Data Services Ireland Drogheda data storage campus, IDA Business and Technology Park, Donore Road, Drogheda, Co. Meath (EPA IE review licence P1181-02, 24 September 2026; Buildings A and B)
entries.reason: New site, prepared but not admitted. The EPA review licence sealed on 24 September 2026 (local epa-P1181-02-final-licence.pdf, scanned) says the existing licensed installation consists of a two-storey data storage building (Building A) and that the review extends it to operate a second building (Building B), with 54 diesel generators per the licence introduction; the Technical Committee report of 10 September 2026 calls it an expansion of an existing data centre and records the licensee's objection statement that Building B 'is already built', while quoting the inspector that Building B 'has not commenced processes'. Unlike the Clonshaugh licence, neither document says the installation currently operates; operation of Building A would be inferred from the licence's six-month allowance for its evaporative cooling discharges and from the licensee's 9 September incident notice of routine maintenance on a CRAC unit on 31 August 2026. Building B's 'already built' statement dates from the licensee's objection (on or before 27 May 2026), outside the window, and an EPA licence is not planning consent, so no in-window status beyond announced is explicit for Building B; recording Building B as announced would understate a building its operator says is built. Locator ready: EPA register NGR N274070 E306705 -> 53.705579, -6.3849122 (TM75 to WGS84), 57.7 m from the Meath 21663 register point (second data storage building, ABP-310729-21) and 221 m from LB191735 (first building). No Atlas record within 2 km.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated (within 85 days) EPA, licensee or Amazon record that explicitly states current operation of Building A (for example an EPA site-visit report, a licensee return or the 2026 annual environmental report), or a dated completion or operation record for Building B; then admit the site with the prepared EPA site-centre locator and add the other building as a second project in a later update.
